## About
Value Auto Clinic is an owner operated shop on Gillham Rd, near Crown Center. When you bring your car or light truck in, you deal with the decision maker.
We like to involve you in your vehicle's repair. That means giving you options and recommendations so you can decide what makes sense for your car and your budget.
Call, e-mail or stop by with questions, estimate requests, or to drop off a vehicle. We also have a second location in Lee's Summit, next to Habaneros.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: Tracking down warning lights and hard to find problems.
- Engine work: Engine repair for cars and light trucks.
- Air conditioning work: Keeping your air conditioning working through Kansas City summers.
- Transmission service and replacement
- Missouri vehicle inspection
- Used vehicle inspection: A look over a car you are thinking about buying.
- Manufacturer recommended services

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free. Call, e-mail or stop by to request one.

Q: Can I get a ride after I drop off my car?
A: Yes, local rides are available.

Q: Can you help with towing?
A: Yes. We offer towing with no mark-up.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday. Friday is by appointment. Give us a call to confirm before you come in.

Got a second opinion from Value Auto Clinic and ended up only spending $2k for the same repair. It’s now been 4 months and I just made it to the “prescribed” timeframe for an oil change - this hasn’t happened in MONTHS. Value said everything looks good from the leak side of things. Saved us thousands on repairs and from having to go buy a new car sooner than we wanted.
They also got my husband’s car in quickly for repairs when it had an issue immediately after mine this spring.
To top it off, the owner remembered a conversation about a big project my husband had been working on and remembered to ask me about it 4 months later.
They are easy to communicate with, honest, and so easy to work with. We will never take our cars elsewhere." (Ashley Uryasz, 5/5)
